reason: The design contradiction holds: _residual_tie treats equal bare symbols as one instrument, the enrichment guard says the opposite across exchanges, dedup uses (symbol, exchange), and ISIN drives no identity decision. Correction: this is not purely latent. Same-region ticker collisions exist, and /resolve?q=FOCUS returns NSE 'Focus Lighting and Fixtures' AND BSE 'Focus Business Solution' both carrying the identical ISIN INE0DXR01010 and bse_code 543312. Two distinct companies cannot share an ISIN, so the ticker-string join is already stamping one company's identity on the other. The same root cause also drives COD-resolver-1.
